表示该调用在运行时决定状态码。

## 任务失败原因 / Task failure reasons

`GET /api/task/{task_id}` 响应的 `data.error` 是失败文案文本（通常在失败写入时按服务端语言本地化；没有已存文案时使用当前语言的通用失败文案），不是 locale key；它可能随语言和失败内容变化，因此不稳定、不可用于客户端分支。表中 key 仅供对照文案，不是 API 返回值。

In `GET /api/task/{task_id}`, `data.error` contains failure text (normally localized with the server language when the failure is written; if no text was stored, it uses the generic failure text in the current language), not a locale key. It can vary with language and failure details, so it is unstable and must not be used for client branching. The keys in this table are for looking up the corresponding text only; they are not API response values.

| key | zh-CN 文案 | en 文案 |
|---|---|---|
| `error.task_failure.calibrating_status_write_failed` | 任务状态写入异常: {error} | Task status write failed: {error} |
| `error.task_failure.capswriter_transcript_cache_save_failed` | 保存CapsWriter转录结果到缓存失败 | Failed to save the CapsWriter transcript to cache |
| `error.task_failure.download_file_failed` | 下载文件失败: {url} | Download failed: {url} |
| `error.task_failure.download_info_unavailable` | 无法获取下载信息: {url} | Unable to retrieve download information: {url} |
| `error.task_failure.funasr_transcript_cache_save_failed` | 保存FunASR转录结果到缓存失败 | Failed to save the FunASR transcript to cache |
| `error.task_failure.llm_executor_submit_failed` | 提交LLM任务失败: {error} | Failed to submit the LLM task: {error} |
| `error.task_failure.llm_handoff_queue_failed` | LLM任务加入队列失败: {error} | Failed to enqueue the LLM task: {error} |
| `error.task_failure.llm_processing_failed` | LLM处理失败: {error} | LLM processing failed: {error} |
| `error.task_failure.llm_submit_status_recovered` | LLM 任务提交失败，终态写入曾经失败，已由运行期维护补偿写入 | An earlier LLM task submission failure was recovered by runtime maintenance |
| `error.task_failure.local_upload_mapping_missing` | 本地上传的持久化准入记录或媒体映射缺失 | Local upload durable admission or media mapping is missing |
| `error.task_failure.media_admission_failed` | 媒体准入失败：{error} | Media admission failed: {error} |
| `error.task_failure.notes_queue_failed` | 详细笔记任务加入队列失败: {error} | Detailed notes task queue submission failed: {error} |

## 说明 / Notes

FastAPI 请求体校验产生的 422 响应保留默认形状，不含 `error_code`。应用处理器对其他 Starlette HTTP 错误可能附加 `resource_not_found`、`method_not_allowed` 或 `api_error`；这些框架错误保留原始 `detail`，不属于 locale 文案表。

FastAPI request-validation 422 responses keep their default shape and do not include `error_code`. The application handler may attach `resource_not_found`, `method_not_allowed`, or `api_error` to other Starlette HTTP errors; their original `detail` is preserved, so they are not locale strings listed above.
